purpose: Empirically characterize the GPT-6 Sol / Instant execution envelope that matters to decomposition, retry, synthesis and stronger-effort routing without attempting to infer undocumented hidden reasoning budgets.

current_executor_identity.identity_rule: Record the exact surface-reported identity at every run; mismatch invalidates the run for current-profile calibration.

non_goals: claim Instant and High are globally equivalent
measure browser RAM or operator UX
re-run every historical GPT-5.6 screening fixture
treat tool/transport failure as model reasoning failure

causal_axes.description: Increase the number of mutually dependent constraints required for one irreducible decision while keeping context/horizon bounded.
Increase independent sequential/parallel work units while keeping each unit easy and low-coupling.
Increase supplied context volume and distractors while holding the relevant reasoning problem constant.
Increase independent branch count and compare whole-task execution with decomposition.
Increase the number of already-validated leaf results that one synthesizer must integrate.
Increase serial tool-call/action depth while holding reasoning difficulty roughly constant.
Measure recovery after one or more objective validator failures with bounded feedback.
Compare persistent-chat continuation with fresh durable-resume quanta under identical packets.

matched_treatments.rule: Keep surface, tools, fixture, packet compiler, validation and authority constant; vary thinking configuration only for causal Instant-vs-High comparisons.

experiment_families.outcome: Find the earliest level where Instant validated success/reliability diverges materially from High.

metrics: tool calls and failed tool calls
hard_gates: same exact GPT-6 Sol generation/surface for Instant and High matched controls
zero hidden-oracle exposure for claim-bearing runs
no use of hidden reasoning-token estimates as ground truth
initial_execution_order: Begin backend Phase-1 deterministic kernel immediately with telemetry hooks.
Run real user workflows through shadow/bounded Instant workers and accumulate execution-envelope evidence.
Prioritize naturally occurring examples of coupling, decomposition/horizon, synthesis fan-in, and validator repair.
Use compact sentinels only after real evidence suggests a threshold/failure mode or when executor identity changes.
production_profile_rule: Continuously update phenotype-specific routing evidence from validated real workflows. Model/surface changes trigger a compact sentinel suite plus fresh real-workflow observations; full synthetic profiling is not a release prerequisite unless a specific unresolved mechanism requires it.

real_workflow_first_policy.rule: Do not block backend implementation on weeks of isolated synthetic characterization. Learn the GPT-6 Instant envelope primarily from the user's actual workflows while running the orchestrator in instrumented shadow/bounded mode.
synthetic_use_only: small sentinel regression after model/surface/toolset changes
controlled reproduction of failure modes discovered in real workflows
